These dPPAD_T2 numbers are INFERRED; 11 files 10341-10351 not deposited
Headers WT_T3_Frac01-10 (different spelling) repeat fractions 1-10 of WT_T3; Data_Overview lists 06504-06515 under WT_T3_Rep2. Interpreted as re-acquisition (inferred)
Raw headers: 'Method of Q Exactive HF' / 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS' in all sampled files and protocol text; PRIDE instruments field says Q Exactive (overridden)
Methylated trypsin digestion; X!Tandem cleavage site [KR]|{P}, max 2 missed cleavages

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M, Deamidated N/Q/R variable
claims.evidence: X!Tandem input: 57.0215@C fixed; potential 15.9949@M,0.984@Q,0.984@N,0.984@R in sampled XMLs. Protocol text lists deamidation [N,Q] only; R deamidation (citrullination) comes from the XMLs and the study aim
X!Tandem parent error 10 ppm in all sampled XMLs; protocol text 10 ppm
Conflict: protocol text 0.02 Da; deposited X!Tandem XMLs 0.10 Da (4 files) and 0.20 Da (QEHF2_06550); not constant across deposit
sampleProcessingProtocol: DTT 10 mM then iodoacetamide 24 mM
Protocol: off-line HPLC fractionation in HFBA (2D HFBA separation); Frac_NN sample IDs in raw headers. Selected term is generic HPLC (PRIDE:0000565)
Top5/Top10 methods in raw headers (30min_TwoColumnSetup_Charg1_Top5/Top10, Top5_30minGradient)
All 256 raw headers: Fragmentation_HCD, normalized energy 30, method names *_HCD30_*
Outer membrane vesicles of a bacterial culture; no host tissue, cell type or disease

limitations: Full text of the MCP paper was not retrievable; paper Methods not independently read.
Run-to-sample map is from raw-file header sample IDs plus Data_Overview.docx; Data_Overview ranges are internally inconsistent for the QEHF3 series.
26 QEHF3_*.mzXML.MGX peak-list files, 225+ X!Tandem XMLs and Data_Overview.docx are not annotated.
Strain (W83 vs ATCC 33277) of the experimental cultures is not stated in the available record.
WT_T2_Rep2 vs WT_T3_Rep2 vs Data_Overview ranges overlap; raw headers were followed, so biological replicates 4/5 could be swapped.
Fragment mass tolerance left not available (protocol 0.02 Da vs XMLs 0.10/0.20 Da).
dPPAD_T2 fraction numbers are inferred from run order; real numbers unrecoverable.
Biological replicate indices restart for the 2D WT series (as in Data_Overview); whether those cultures are independent of WT_T2/WT_T3 is unknown.
